title: Terminal: Core Loop
summary: Open the right tab, claim the useful record, act, and return with better context.

blocks.title: Repeatable Loop
blocks.body: Open the relevant tab, review records or rewards, follow links into Wiki or Index, act on the plan, then return to update the terminal state.

blocks.title: Pressure Check
blocks.body: After each check-in, decide whether Terminal gave you a route, recipe, reward, warning, or next page. Keep the useful tab close.

blocks.title: Stop Point
blocks.body: Stop navigating menus once the next action is clear. Terminal is an operations desk, not a place to hide from the route.

blocks.title: Loop Check
blocks.body: Run the loop once more only if the return path, inventory space, and next upgrade are clear.
